name: Roast Beef "Grilled" Mozzarella & Blue Cheese Sandwiches on Rye with Horseradish Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and chop chives into small pieces. Place in a small bowl along with sour cream, mayo, horseradish, Worcestershire, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the horseradish sauce and refrigerate until ready to serve.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ small pkg chives
½ cup sour cream
⅓ cup mayonnaise
¼ cup horseradish, prepared
2 tsp Worcestershire sauce
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut blue cheese into ¼-inch thick slices.
Arrange half of the bread slices on a baking sheet pan, then layer with blue cheese, roast beef, and mozzarella. Season with salt and pepper, then close sandwiches with remaining bread slices.
instructions.secondary_message:
8 slice rye bread
454 g deli roast beef, sliced
8 slice mozzarella cheese, sliced
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat an outdoor grill or grill pan over medium-high heat.
While the grill heats up, spread mayo on the top side of the sandwiches.
Once the grill is hot, add sandwiches, mayo-side down, and grill until bottoms are golden, 2-4 minutes. (Reserve baking sheet for the next step.)

Remove sandwiches to the baking sheet, grilled-side down, and spread the other side with additional mayo. Return sandwiches, mayo-side down, to the grill and continue to cook until golden on the other side and cheese is melted, 2-4 minutes more. Transfer to a cutting board.
Slice sandwiches in half and divide between plates. Serve with horseradish sauce for dipping and enjoy!
